findings.label: H1
findings.text: hooks/guard/common.py:624 (ere_escape) — The port "fixes" a quirk of the shell guard, so decisions move. The shell's ere_escape (lib/ai-hook-common.sh:137) lists '\\' in a single-quoted case pattern; that is two characters, so a single backslash in a token is never escaped. The port's escape set is a one-character string containing a backslash, so it escapes it.
